# Hyper-Scale Lab / Precalc Odyssey

> Free interactive precalculus lab with graphs, worked solutions, and a full public guide library with diagrams.

## Site
- Home: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/
- Guides: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/
- Lab: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/hyper-scale/
